description: This file is a web page for the troubleshooting section of a gateway device, providing options to reset or restore various system components such as Wi-Fi, password, and factory settings. It includes PHP includes for header/footer, HTML structure, and JavaScript for handling user interactions and device resets.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends reset or restore commands to the server with information about the selected action and handles UI feedback during the process.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Checks if the device has rebooted by polling the index page; redirects to login upon success.

methods.name: setBatteryInfo
methods.description: Sends battery reset information to the server.
